description: This file provides a SQLite database adapter for the notes_backend project, including a dataclass for database info, a context manager for database connections, and an execute function for running SQL commands.

classes.name: SqliteDb
classes.description: Dataclass representing the SQLite database path.

methods.name: Iterator[sqlite3.Connection] sqlite_connection(db: SqliteDb)
methods.description: Context manager that provides a SQLite connection, managing opening and closing, with proper transaction handling.

methods.name: sqlite3.Cursor execute(conn: sqlite3.Connection, sql: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None)
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement on a given SQLite connection with optional parameters.

ctags.name: execute
ctags.pattern: /^def execute(conn: sqlite3.Connection, sql: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None) -> sqlite3.Curso/
ctags.signature: (conn: sqlite3.Connection, sql: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None)
